text_block_list.text:
On the very day our challenge in the Twinkle Series began,
a mock race was being held on academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

Leaping into the lead from the opening stretch,
she doesn't slow down at all—in fact, her unbelievable
late surge leaves everyone else in the dust.

Putting on a display of a textbook "big breakaway" in the mock race,
her running sent waves of astonishment through the entire venue.
—"An unbelievable talent has emerged."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*..., *phew*...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (...A pleasant breeze.)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoooo! Suzuka~!
Nice run out there~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh. Taiki.
(Taiki Shuttle—a cheerful and powerful Umamusume who came all the way from America.)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Even with that cool expression, Suzuka is totally fired up after all, yes~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I heard from someone in my class
that your Debut Race is coming up soon!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've got a Trainer,
you're gonna run in the Twinkle Series, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Good news from my friends makes me very, very happy!
Because I'm always cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mmm-, cool as ever!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... well...
I'm not sure what to say...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then,
I want to know what Suzuka's dream is, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Is it the Triple Crown after all?!
Or giving courage to the whole world, and stuff like that?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: U-Umm...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I don't really have anything like a dream, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: In the Twinkle Series too!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I just want to see the view from the front...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Other than that, not really...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... High pace, my pace...!
It seemed this conversation had been overheard by those around them—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka was
incredibly fast, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: She's a bit of an unusual girl, isn't she?

—In every sense of the word, it seemed to have been
a mock race that set the entire crowd abuzz.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
There you are.
choice_data_list: The "big runaway lead" was a huge success.
The "big runaway lead" was a huge success.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's been a long time
since I last ran on the course with such freedom.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It feels like I haven't run nearly enough...
choice_data_list: It made me happy to see you running with such joy.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Were you... "happy"?
choice_data_list: Because I'm one of the people captivated by your running, too.
After all, I'm one of those who was captivated by your running

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: I want you to keep running just the way you want to.
I want you to keep running just the way you want to.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...You really place a lot of trust in me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"No, um... I kind of felt it
ever since our training session."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
A high-risk tactic like "Runaway Front-Runner"...
Usually, people wouldn't let you try it so easily...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Even so, without ever denying my ideals,
you helped me strive toward them...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Which is why, um...
Thank you.
choice_data_list: Next up is your debut race, huh.
Next up is your debut race, right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"The Debut Race"...
Once we get past that, I'm sure things will be even more...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I'm looking forward to it.

"Silence Suzuka loves running more than anyone else.
And so, the days of pushing past limits alongside her began."
